title: Data-Driven Estimation of Vinnicombe metric
summary: Quantifying model mismatch in a control-relevant manner is fundamental in robust control. A well-known metric for this purpose is the $ν$-gap, or Vinnicombe metric, which measures the discrepancy between a nominal model and the real system from a closed-loop viewpoint. However, its computation typically requires explicit knowledge of the true system. In this letter, we propose an identification-free, data-driven method to estimate the $ν$-gap between discrete-time SISO systems directly from input-output experiments.
